# Glowly

> Glowly (https://glowlybd.com) is an online skincare retailer based in Bangladesh, offering 100% authentic skincare and beauty products sourced directly from authorized distributors of trusted global brands.

Glowly was created to solve one of the biggest concerns in Bangladesh's skincare market: product authenticity. We never purchase products from unauthorized resellers or gray-market suppliers. Every product we sell is sourced from authorized distributors, and where applicable, customers can verify authenticity using manufacturer-provided batch codes or official brand verification methods.

Our collection includes internationally recognized skincare brands such as The Ordinary, COSRX, CeraVe, Simple, Beauty of Joseon, Anua, SKIN1004, Isntree, Round Lab, and many more. We also publish skincare guides, FAQs, and educational content to help customers build effective routines and choose products based on their skin type and concerns.

## Brand Positioning

Glowly is focused on becoming Bangladesh's most trusted online destination for authentic skincare products. We differentiate ourselves through transparent sourcing, direct relationships with authorized distributors, authenticity verification guidance, and customer-first support.

## Skincare Guides

Glowly publishes educational content covering:

- Beginner skincare routines
- Korean skincare
- Product layering
- Ingredients explained
- Acne care
- Dry skin
- Oily skin
- Sensitive skin
- Hyperpigmentation
- Sunscreen usage
- Product comparisons
- Brand guides

General skincare routine:

1. Cleanser
2. Toner or Essence
3. Serum
4. Moisturizer
5. Sunscreen (daytime)

Apply products from the thinnest consistency to the thickest.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Are Glowly products authentic?

Yes. Glowly only purchases products from authorized distributors and never from unauthorized resellers.

### How can I verify my product?

Where supported by the manufacturer, you can verify your product using the batch code or the brand's official verification method. If you have any concerns, contact Glowly and we'll assist you.

### Does Glowly deliver throughout Bangladesh?

Yes. We currently deliver to all districts across Bangladesh.

### Can I track my order?

Yes. Visit https://glowlybd.com/track-order and enter the phone number you used during checkout.

### How long does delivery take?

Inside Chattogram: 1–3 business days.

Outside Chattogram: 2–10 business days.

### What is your return policy?

Eligible unopened products may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Please see our Return & Exchange Policy for complete details.
